## QUESTION 2

__Which airport has the worst delays?__ Describe the metric you chose, and why you chose it to determine the “worst” airport. Your answer should include a summary table that lists (for each airport) the total number of flights, total number of delayed flights, proportion of delayed flights, and average delay time in hours. 

I decided that the worst airport is the one that has the highest proportion of delayed flights because it measures the ineficiency of that airport. Using that metric, the San Francisco airport is considered the worst airport.

would be the one that has the highest proportion of delayed flights
San Diego airport has the highest proportion of delayed flights.

```{python}
# Include and execute your code here
# pior eh o que tem mais atrasos e mais longos?
# TOTAL NUMBER OF FLIGHTS = num_of_delays_total

#

worse_airport = df.group_by('airport_name').agg(pl.col('num_of_flights_total').sum().alias('Total Flights'), 
# print(airports)

pl.col('num_of_delays_total').sum().alias('Total Delayed Flights'), 

(pl.col('num_of_delays_total').sum() / pl.col('num_of_flights_total').sum()).alias('Proportion of Delayed flights'),

((pl.col('minutes_delayed_total').sum() / 60) / pl.col('num_of_delays_total').sum()).alias('Average Delay Time in Hours')).sort('Proportion of Delayed flights', descending=True)


print(worse_airport)




```
